title: SOVOS Bus Portal · Inner + Outer · StateBus Visualization
description: SOVOS Bus Portal — generalized from charter-portal. Inner view shows the StateBus state (water/milk/honey vectors), outer view shows the interaction surface (birth events, gate evaluations). Real Bus data via the Redis layer.
text: SOVOS Bus Portal · Inner + Outer · StateBus Visualization ⟁ SOVOS Bus Portal · Inner + Outer Generalized from charter-portal · Bus state via sovos-bus-redis ← charter-portal (3D) ⟁ Inner Portal · StateBus Read View All vectors across all layers. Click a vector to see its coordinate + payload. 0 total 0 water 0 milk 0 honey 0 action+control Inner portal reads from the StateBus (sovos-bus-redis). In this static demo, the bus is initialised with sample data — in production, it connects to a real Redis (or fakeredis for dev). Click a vector to see its full coordinate and payload. ⟁ Outer Portal · Interaction Surface Submit events to the Bus. Each append gets a chain_id. ⚡ Birth (Mode 0) ⚖ Article 0 Gate 🔗 Sheaf Gate Display name User ID Namespace sovos iokfarm meok csoai defoneos ⚡ BIRTH · Append to Bus Paste a StateVector JSON to evaluate against Article 0. Same rules as sovos_article_zero.evaluate() . StateVector JSON {"source":"birth:iokfarm","layer":"water","vector":[0.1,0.2,0.3],"payload":{"user_id":"alice"},"sv_id":"abc123def4567890abcdef01"} ⚖ EVALUATE Two buses (as JSON dicts of sv_id → vector). The sheaf gate decides whether they can be safely merged. Bus A {"s1":[1.0,0.0,0.0],"s2":[0.0,1.0,0.0]} Bus B {"s1":[1.0,0.0,0.0],"s2":[0.0,1.0,0.0]} 🔗 CHECK SHEAF Outer portal drives the Bus. Every interaction emits a chain_id that lands in the inner view. Mode 0 = birth. Article 0 = governance gate. Sheaf = federation safety. All three are wired to the same RedisBus.
